preventionContract: Never derive create_tree base_tree_sha from an optional or absent fetch_commit tree field.
For every control-only composition, use an explicitly proven full canonical tree SHA.
Before moving the branch, create a detached probe commit and compare it against the last known-good control commit.
Require byte-parity readback of workflow, .firebaserc, AGENTS.md and relevant product owners; reject any unexpected removed file.
